page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; text in one main block of verse and short lines, with two parallel verse columns in the lower half (left and right of a central rule). No marginal notes of legible text; faded show-through from the other side is ignored. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: Sancta Maria succurre miseris, juva pusil-lanimes, refove flebiles. Ora p populo, interveni pro clero, intercede p devoto foemineo sexu.
main_text.head: ET:
main_text.l: Ut sicut tu compassa es Nato in agone;
Sic huic conregnando Me socium fac coronae.
main_text.head: ET:
main_text.p: Ave gloriosa mater Maria, Mater Christi, virgo pia, pone misericordiam et compassionem tuam inter judicium dilecti Filii tui et meam miseram animam.
main_text.head: ET:

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse side in the margins and lower left; the lower-left fragment is illegible. Italic and black-letter marks such as "p" and "Ε T" are printed as rubrics; the "ET:" rubrics are treated as headings. Some verse lines are set in two parallel columns and the transcription follows column order.
